xna-type.name: Album
xna-type.summary: Provides access to an album in the media library.
xna-type.remarks: The Album class provides information about an album, including the album's Name , Artist , and Songs . You can obtain an Album object through the AlbumCollection.Item indexer and the Song.Album property.

property.name: Artist
property.summary: Gets the Artist of the Album.

property.name: Duration
property.summary: Gets the duration of the Album.
property.remarks: The duration is the total duration of all of the album's songs that are present on the device. This may be less than the duration attributed to the entire album.

property.name: Genre
property.summary: Gets the Genre of the Album.

property.name: HasArt
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the Album has associated album art.

property.name: IsDisposed
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the object is disposed.

property.name: Name
property.summary: Gets the name of the Album.

property.name: Songs
property.summary: Gets a SongCollection that contains the songs on the album.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

overload.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

method.summary: Determines whether the specified Album is equal to this Album.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified Album is equal to this Album.

parameters.parameter: Album to compare with this instance.

overload.returns: true if the objects are equal; false otherwise.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified Object is equal to this Album.

method.name: Finalize
method.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the Album is reclaimed by garbage collection.

overload.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the Album is reclaimed by garbage collection.
overload.remarks: This method overrides Finalize System.Object.Finalize . Application code should not call this method. The object's Finalize method is automatically invoked during garbage collection, unless a call to the GC.SuppressFinalize method has disabled finalization by the garbage collector. For more information, see Finalize Methods and Destructors , Cleaning Up Unmanaged Resources , and Overriding the Finalize Method .

overload.returns: Texture with the album art thumbnail, or null if the album has no associated thumbnail.
